From: mail01@corvane.example

Subject: RE: VSL-01 OFF-HIRE NOTICE 10 OCT 2026

Dear Colleagues,

Charterer agrees to the 6.0 h and asks for the log extract before agreeing the speed part.

- Offhire accepted: 6.0 hours

Best regards,
Corvane Bulk Trading

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-11 09:50:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@corvane.example
Cc: mail01@aureliabay.example
Subject: RE: VSL-01 OFF-HIRE NOTICE 10 OCT 2026

Dear Charterers,

Operator accepts the 6.0 h stoppage as off-hire time but disputes the speed claim: the vessel regained 11.8 kn within 3 h and the reduced-speed period is net loss of 3.5 h only if the warranty is 12.0 kn; asks for the speed log extract.

- Offhire accepted: 6.0 hours
- Net speed loss: 3.5 hours

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@corvane.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 16:30:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@aureliabay.example
Subject: VSL-01 OFF-HIRE NOTICE 10 OCT 2026

Dear Colleagues,

Charterer notifies off-hire for the whole stoppage and a speed shortfall afterwards, citing the CP off-hire clause.

- Offhire claimed: 6.0 hours
- Offhire clause: clause 17

Best regards,
Corvane Bulk Trading

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@vsl01.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 08:40:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@norvikservice.example
Subject: VSL-01 M/E NO.4 CYL EXHAUST VALVE - REDUCED SPEED

Dear Colleagues,

Master reports a stoppage to change the no.4 exhaust valve; engine stopped 02:10 to 08:10.

- Stop from: 2026-10-10 02:10
- Stop to: 2026-10-10 08:10
- Stop: 6.0 hours
- Cause: exhaust valve no.4 spindle seat leak

Best regards,
Master MV Aurelia Bay
